test.observed_assertion: Stopped serial consumer acknowledged unsampled reset

semantics: Witness requires consumer clock to sample final local reset LOW on release before later HIGH ACK. Unsampled short reset is not acknowledged and requires a new complete sampled epoch.
ACK is traffic/occupancy independent and cannot use t_rdy or a fixed counter.
Existing real CDC rendezvous remains required; opposite-domain stopped clock blocks complete startup.
Controller must mask both reset requests during epochs and synchronize each ACK separately before reduction. No independent partial-reset admission claim.
